    "Theoretical_Framework": "Not explicitly stated, but implicitly grounded in theories of regional integration and standardization of professional education.",

  "KEY_FINDINGS": {
    "Main_Findings": [
      "Significant progress has been made towards harmonizing medical education in the EAC, but challenges remain.",
      "Variations in curricula, assessment methods, and accreditation standards exist across EAC partner states.",
      "Mutual recognition of medical qualifications is crucial for facilitating cross-border mobility of healthcare professionals.",
      "Regional collaboration and political will are essential for successful harmonization."
    ],
    "Challenges_Barriers": [
      "Lack of resources",
      "Political instability",
      "Varying levels of infrastructure",
      "Resistance to change from some stakeholders",
      "Differences in language and culture"
    ],
    "Success_Factors": [
      "Strong political commitment from EAC partner states",
      "Active involvement of medical schools and regulatory bodies",
      "Availability of funding and technical support",
      "Effective communication and collaboration among stakeholders"
    ],
    "Recommendations": [
      "Strengthen regional accreditation mechanisms",
      "Develop common curricula and assessment standards",
      "Promote cross-border exchange programs for students and faculty",
      "Invest in infrastructure and resources for medical education",
      "Enhance collaboration and communication among stakeholders"
    ],
    "Future_Research": [
      "Further research is needed to evaluate the impact of harmonization efforts on the quality of healthcare and patient outcomes.",
      "Studies are needed to identify best practices for implementing harmonization initiatives in different contexts.",
      "Research is needed to assess the cost-effectiveness of harmonization efforts."
    ],
    "Specific_Examples": [
      "The East African Health Research Commission (EAHRC) has played a key role in coordinating research and promoting evidence-based policy-making in the region.",
      "The EAC Medical and Dental Practitioners Council is working to develop common standards for medical education and practice."
